judgment_rule: Buffer Cache Hit Ratio > 95% 判定为正常
user_input: 帮我看看缓冲区的命中率怎么样，是不是正常。

assertions.name: Buffer Cache Hit Ratio 判断
assertions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND((1 - (SUM(CASE WHEN e.stat_name='physical reads' THEN e.value-b.value ELSE 0 END) / GREATEST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.stat_name IN ('db block gets','consistent gets') THEN e.value-b.value ELSE 0 END),1))) * 100, 2) AS buffer_hit_pct FROM dba_hist_sysstat e JOIN dba_hist_sysstat b ON e.stat_name=b.stat_name AND b.snap_id=(SELECT MIN(snap_id) FROM dba_hist_snapshot) WHERE e.snap_id=(SELECT MAX(snap_id) FROM dba_hist_snapshot) AND e.stat_name IN ('physical reads','db block gets','consistent gets')
